rows.en: Hey, what are you doing!? You're supposed to be lying down!!
I told you you needed complete bed rest!! I can't believe you!!
No, I'm on standby here so I'm ready the moment the order to sortie comes...
Quiet!!
Quit your excuses, we're going!!
Ow, ow, ow, ow!!
At this rate, he's only going to get worse.
What? The match venue's been changed?
Hmph... Looks like the enemy's starting to show their true colors, huh?
Interesting. If it were me, I'd act like I'd been fooled and feel out the enemy's next move.
...So Ankh said he'd fight to get back to his own world, rather than for the Medals?
That's right! Pretty amazing, huh? Ankh's really changed.
Yay! Yay! I wanna hurry up and take the DenLiner to go see Big Sis!!
Idiots! I'm not doing this for your sake.
Oh, quit acting tough!!
Shut up!! I'm under no obligation to help you lot!
Oh! Come to think of it, Urataros told me there are some really tasty ice pops, but...
...What?
He said he'd bring them out if you keep helping us from here on.
...If that's how it is, that's a different story.
I'll help you a little while longer.
But I'm still collecting Medals from here on. And you're going to help me with that.
So you want the Medals after all.
Shut up. Hey, hurry up and bring out the ice pops.
Yes, yes.
This place... seems to be some kind of rest area.
...Well, hey, if it isn't God Gundam.
You... know who I am?
I saw you once before, inside a Cube.
You were fightin' like nothin' else in the world existed, weren't ya?
Ya were sayin' somethin' about yer hand burnin', weren't ya?
I see. I didn't notice at all.
Hey, hey, show me that thing again~ That whatever-Finger thing!!
The God Finger is not a sideshow.
Tch! Meanie.
...Well, since you came all this way, at least stay for a cup of coffee.
Yes, I'll have one.
We've defeated Grand Gundam. That leaves two of the Four Heavenly Kings...
Mind if I ask you something?
What is it? That's unusual for you.
That technique you used to smash the ice wall...
The Sekiha Tenkyoken?
Is that a technique you earned through your training?
Not only that. It's what you'd call an "ultimate technique."
A technique only those who have attained the state of "Meikyo Shisui" can unleash...
Back then, cornered, I pulled it off by a miracle. But since coming here, I've lost the feel for it.
I see... I've done plenty of training myself, so I figured I'd have you teach it to me.
Too bad for you.
Then next time, I'll show you MY technique, "Big Bang Zero"!
It's not quite the Sekiha Tenkyoken, but I'm confident it won't lose to the God Finger!
That's quite some confidence.
Yeah! I wrap my fist in flames and slam a knife-hand chop into the foe with all I've got!!
'Cause this hand of mine is literally burnin' red!
But I'm getting it back through battle. You'll get there someday too.
Then next time, I'll get to see what you can do.
Sounds like the final tournament has started.
I'd love to go cheer you on, but I'm busy.
Well, you lot'll win!! Want me to tell ya why?
In this world, when it comes down to it, there's only two kinds of "strength."
Huh~? What are they?
Strength that'll make ya cry, and strength that won't! Relax! Yours is the kind that'll make ya cry!
...Not that it matters, but Kin-chan, you're talking like it's none of your business.
I only get called out once in a while, so my body's gettin' rusty, I tell ya.
Hey! What happened to Ultraman Taros!!
Sempai, I told you, it's Taro!
Don't tell me ya came back without savin' him!? You're a heartless jerk!!
So? How's this latest Cube?
I heard there should be all kinds of items in there, right?
Huh~ So they've got kaiju and kaijin on display in cages.
Sounds just like a zoo.
Wow! I wanna go see too~!!
Dummy! If a guy like you went, they'd lock ya in a cage and put ya on display!
Momo! Same goes for you!
Whaddya say!? Bear! Have YOU ever looked in a mirror!!
Uuugh... I can't stop shakin'...
Huh? Did you catch a cold or something?
No, inside the Cube... Hoooooo... It's no good, I can't put it into words...
What happened in there?
Ah, that was... how do I put it... I guess you could call it a swamp of terror...
OOO!! Don't say another word!! It'll all come back to me...

notes.note: No speaker in the script; Accel's pained cry as Methuss hauls the injured man away, which #0.286 comments on.
'Moto no sekai' = Ankh's own world; Medals left generic (no Core/Cell in source). Ankh g=m.
Ryutaros's 'onee-chan' (Airi in Den-O) rendered 'Big Sis'; no earlier English precedent found.
'Aisu' = ice pops per Ankh's glossary note / talk_005 #0.203. Sentence trails off; kept.
Subject 'he' = Urataros (from #0.305), who would 'bring them out'.
'Taoshita na' has no subject; God Gundam noting the party's victory, rendered 'We'. Four Heavenly Kings per glossary.
'Ougi' = a school's secret ultimate technique; rendered 'ultimate technique' in quotes as the source brackets it.
'Meikyo Shisui' kept in romaji, matching the existing 'State of Meikyo Shisui' line.
Tightened to fit: 'kono sekai ni kite' = 'since coming here' (this world).
'Big Bang Zero' = Ultraman Zero's flaming chop (Ultraman Zero Gaiden); not in glossary. 'MY' stresses the contrast with God Gundam's technique.
Zero borrowing God Gundam's catchphrase ('My hand is burnin' red!' per glossary) as a joke, since his move literally sets his hand ablaze.

Speaker uncertain: talkspk finds no script reference (possibly unused). Read as God Gundam (neutral 'darou' ending, not Zero's rough 'ze'): he is regaining the lost feel for Meikyo Shisui in battle and Zero will reach it too. If Zero speaks it, 'it' = his own lost power and the English still reads acceptably.
Kintaros to the party; 'you lot' restores the plural listener.
Kintaros's 'nakeru tsuyosa' = strength so great it makes you cry, tied to his catchphrase 'You'll cry!'.
'Yobarehen' = seldom called out (into the party / battle); subject 'I' restored.
'Ultraman Taros' is Momotaros's deliberate mix-up, as in story slices; corrected by Urataros in #0.366.
Momotaros scolding the party leader for returning without Taro; 'hidee yatsu' kept harsh.
Kintaros's 'Momo no ji' rendered 'Momo', as in story (MainEventMess0144 #0.40).
'Swamp of terror' literal; the Cube's horror is not named here.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers taken from talkspk.py Quest (slice labels empty). Uncertain: #0.348 speaker (no script reference; read as God Gundam), #0.285 assigned to Accel. Not in glossary: Big Bang Zero (Zero's attack), 'Big Sis' (Ryutaros's onee-chan); Meikyo Shisui romaji matches existing line.
